risks.quote: Hallucinations in generative AI are when the generative AI tools generate content that is factually incorrect, such as creating fictitious historical figures or generating links that are nonexistent.
They should be aware that GenAI systems can generate harmful, misleading, biased, or discriminatory content.
They should be aware that GenAI systems can generate harmful, misleading, biased, or discriminatory content.
Staff should be vigilant to the potential for any GenAI tools used to generate inequalities, e.g. as part of individualised feedback.
Students should actively consider the potential for a particular GenAI tool to be exclusionary or biased and call out such outputs when possible

responsibilities.quote: Users of GenAI must consider the ethical and legal implications when using GenAI tools.
Staff are personally accountable for the use and outputs of GenAI which are used as part of academic practice, i.e. marking decision, provision of feedback etc.
Students are personally accountable for the use and outputs of GenAI which are submitted as part of an assessment.
Students accept that they are wholly responsible for ensuring the veracity, accuracy and/or creative merit of the output generated by any artificial intelligence model.
GenAI should not be solely used to make decisions about the quality of a student, although it may be used supportively.
Students should familiarise themselves with the capabilities and limitations of any Generative AI tool or system they propose to use
This statement is a living document that will be reviewed annually and updated as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) technologies evolve
